notes: Category 3 of the taxonomy in docs/pool_edge_plan.md: the interval contains both zero AND the hypothesised effect, so the test said nothing. These are NOT negatives.
The evaluator resolves ~2 ATS points (RWB-15). Most single features are worth a fraction of that, so landing here is the DEFAULT outcome for a real small signal.
Effects are stored so POSITIVE FAVOURS THE CANDIDATE regardless of the metric's own polarity; Brier and MAE must be negated before recording.
A pooled estimate justifies ONE predeclared combined look on a rotation window none of the inputs touched. It is never itself a finding.

fourth_down_aggressiveness.classification_evidence: The completely-unpriced hypothesis is +0.174 pts and sits INSIDE the interval. Resolving it at 95% needs ~24,000 games, about 90 NFL seasons.
fourth_down_aggressiveness.description: Coach go-for-it rate above situational expectation, lagged a season.
fourth_down_aggressiveness.notes: Reliability is measured relative to each season's league norm, which strips the league-wide drift toward going for it; the naive figure is +0.666. The 0.123 EPA-points/game magnitude is a bin-EPA estimate that selection likely inflates.

penalty_discipline.classification_evidence: A 0.67-point quartile gap (49.85% vs 50.52%) on quartile-sized samples cannot separate 'priced' from 'too small to see'.
penalty_discipline.description: Team penalty rate, quartile split against the market.
penalty_discipline.notes: Scale corrected 2026-08-17: was recorded as 0.0067 (a fraction) while fourth_down_aggressiveness used points, which would have made any pool of the two silently meaningless. accuracy_points are PERCENTAGE POINTS. Still carries no interval, so it cannot be pooled until re-measured with one.

player_qb_continuity_matched_alpha.classification_evidence: The PRIMARY comparison that closed this family ran the candidate at ridge alpha 1.0 against a baseline at 10.0, bundling a feature change with an alpha change. It returned exactly 0.000. The artifact's own alpha-matched arm returns +1.1033 accuracy points (season 95% [0.0000, +2.2177]) and the alpha change alone costs -1.1033 (season 95% [-1.7034, -0.7992], resolvably negative). The two cancel. The predeclared expected effect was 1.25, which the matched arm nearly reproduces.
player_qb_continuity_matched_alpha.description: QB + lineup continuity features, compared at MATCHED regularization rather than against a baseline at a different ridge alpha.
player_qb_continuity_matched_alpha.notes: The window [2014, 2017] is SPENT and must never be re-scored -- this entry records a re-reading of what was already measured, not a new look. The deployable question ('is this configuration better than the frozen one?') was answered honestly as no; the family question ('do these features carry signal?') was not answered at all and should never have been described as closed. Actionable reading: the features want less regularization than the rest of the design, and a single global alpha cannot give them that -- group-wise ridge penalties are the mechanism this implies.
